title: Noah capacity lane quicklog
content:
Daily quicklog - working lane for capacity/burst day. Mostly checklist + scratch notes.

Top-of-shift notes (09:15):
- Quick health sweep of prod-gpu-* pools. focus on pool-ops-3 (high preemptible reclaim noticed yesterday).
- Expected tickets: INFRA-8423 (burst autoscale under-provision), small customer impacted.
- Slack watch: #gpu-ops, #capacity-alerts (set notifications for @noah)

Morning checklist (musts):
- [ ] Confirm auto-scaler condition thresholds for pool-ops-3 (cpu < 40% for 5m -> scale-down). check current config: `kubectl get hpa -n infra pool-ops-3-hpa -o yaml`
- [ ] Run quick capacity forecast for next 6h (script: `scripts/capacity/forecast.py --window 6h --pools pool-ops-3,pool-edge-1`) -> add slack snippet to #capacity-alerts if > 80% util predicted
- [ ] Verify GPU driver updates on canary nodes (nv driver 525 -> 535 planned). `ssh canary-02 && nvidia-smi` -> log version
- [ ] Reconcile reserved instances billing ledger (ping finance if tags mismatch) - brief note to Maya: billing tag mismatch on pool-ops-3 seen 02/17

Troubleshooting scribbles:
- Symptoms: sudden preempts at ~03:00 UTC across us-west-2; suspect spot reclaim + binpack policy too aggressive.
- Quick repro steps: run loadgen against pool-ops-3 with 1.5x baseline; observe node drain behavior.
- Suspected guilty config: `nodeAffinity: preferNoSchedule` + short pod-eviction-grace. Try increasing `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` to 120 for critical inference pods.

Commands I keep repeating:
- `gcloud compute instances describe <node> --zone=us-west2-a | jq .scheduling.preemptible` (check spot)
- `kubectl describe pod <inference-pod> -n hosted-api` (eviction events)
- `./tools/pools/inspect --pool pool-ops-3 --since 6h` (local helper)

Short-term action items (today):
- implement soft-fallback policy for hosted-api route to dedicated-small (canary) if avg latency > 600ms for 1m (thought: add as staged rollout behind feature flag). ETA 3-4h.
- update runbook snippet for preemptible reclaim (add section: how to manually trigger fallback + rollback) - low effort, high value.
- kick off quick quant of cost delta if we enforce min-instances=2 for pool-ops-3 during peak hours (run cost-sim).

Open questions / things to follow up:
- Is there a downstream dependency (logging pipeline) causing slow drains? Need to check fluentd backpressure -> open ticket if true.
- Can we make the autoscaler prefer draining shortest-KV-cache pods first? (idea: label pods with kv-cache-duration and add scoring)

Notes for handoff (if I get pulled):
- Primary: I was about to run forecast script and then update canary hpa. If you continue, run `scripts/capacity/forecast.py --dry-run` first and copy results to #capacity-alerts.
- Emergency: If multiple nodes go NotReady in < 5m, escalate to SRE pager and run `./tools/pools/evict-problematic --pool pool-ops-3` to free scheduling pressure.

Random log snippets / temp ideas:
- Consider short-lived dedicated slot reservations during expected commercial bursts (2-4h) instead of raising baseline min-instances permanently. saves ~$ per day.
- Add metric: percent-requests-served-from-kv-cache_by_model -> will help us know which models need larger KV windows.

Tiny TODOs (5-20m each):
- [ ] Add link to INFRA-8423 in the billing ticket (finance).
- [ ] Drop a note to Liam about testing driver 535 on canary.
- [ ] Add `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 120` trial to feature branch and run CI. (branch: noah/grace-period-trial)

End-of-shift snapshot (write this before leaving):
- forecast run at 12:30 shows peak util 76% for pool-ops-3 between 15:00-17:00 UTC. no immediate action but set alert at 78%.
- placed small canary hpa tweak, results look stable after 18 minutes of traffic.

Random thoughts / scratch (brain dump):
- Would be nice to have a small dashboard tile that shows "fraction of requests falling back to dedicated" per route. Helps correlate regressions to fallback usage.
- Could we expose a lightweight endpoint for clients to signal "low-fidelity allowed" so runtime can route to quantized variants automatically? (policy + client opt-in)

-- noah
(quick personal note: grab coffee before 16:00, standup at 10:30)
